name: sslDeepInspectionEnabled
definition: True when outbound TLS traffic is decrypted for inspection (forward proxy) with a decryption profile in place, covering all outbound traffic and not skipped for all traffic by an earlier rule.
population: the decryption rules (or decryption trust settings) the tool reads
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A successful read of the decryption setup showing forward-proxy decryption with a profile in force across all traffic; a read with no decryption rules or an empty result, a decrypt rule limited to some zones or addresses, an error, an empty body or a possibly cut-off read is Not evaluated.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)
Public OpenAPI reference for Cloud NGFW for AWS (pan.dev/cloudngfw/aws/api/)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Palo Alto firewall transformations (hardware and cloud) can emit it. Meaning is vendor-neutral and written from public references only; no real device or customer read, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: A rule counts as covering all traffic only when every scope field the tool can read (hardware: zones, source, destination, user, URL category and service) is any. Three answers: True for an all-traffic decrypt rule with no all-traffic no-decrypt rule ahead of it; False when no decrypt rule with a profile exists among the rules read, or an all-traffic no-decrypt rule comes first; Not evaluated when the only decrypt rules are limited to some of those fields, because zone names are arbitrary and the tool cannot tell which zone faces the internet. A narrow no-decrypt exception is ignored.
